title: Chapter 259 Join In The Celebration
content:
Chapter 259 Join In The Celebration

Back to the main battlefield, most of the gang members have been captured.

Some escaped.

In the end, there were more than 500 guards left, surrounded.

Wang Shuo came outside the encirclement and heard Zou Yuanjie's report.

These people refused to surrender!

Wang Shuo was a little angry. Do you really think I dare not kill you?

"Li Jianguo, prepare the bronze crossbow carts."

Soon, 70 crossbow carts were facing the surrounded guards.

"Now I will give you one last chance, surrender or die!" Wang Shuo shouted and made the final announcement.

The guards looked at each other. They had also seen the power of the bronze crossbow carts.

At this time, their hearts were hanging.

Watching the crossbow artillery soldiers loading their spears, the guards' hearts were in their throats, and many of them were already sweating!

Their soul awakening level was comparable to that of the bandits in Qingmu Village, and they were considered very intelligent.

In the end, in the face of death, they still surrendered!

In front of more than 5,000 people, they had no chance of escaping, and the other side had thousands of cavalry.

"We surrender!"

...

"Clang"

Countless swords fell to the ground.

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction.

In this battle, more than 12,000 people were captured, and countless weapons and armors!

The Red Flame Army also lost more than 100 people.

Most of them were killed by guards and Utuk.

There were too many captives, and Wang Shuo was a little worried. If he took these captives to attack the city, it would be easy to cause trouble.

So he ordered Ayub to lead the Golden Fire Cavalry to take these captives back to Wana Village and imprison them first.

The cavalry was faster, so they could rush back as quickly as possible.

Then, he took the initiative to contact the lords who were watching the excitement nearby.

He planned to pull all these people into the group.

To become a hegemon, it is impossible to rely on your own force.

Now that Nanshanji has lost all its main forces, it has become meat on the chopping board.

Everyone wants to take a bite. If he does not allow other lords to participate, he may be hated.

If they join, he will directly establish his position as the regional overlord.

In the future, when he competes with other forces, someone will definitely respond. At the very least, it is impossible for them to take advantage of others' misfortune to attack him.

Moreover, after taking out the heart of the town, this Nanshanji is no longer of great strategic significance.

Wang Shuo immediately ordered people to put chairs on the plain, offer fruits, and invite all the lords present to discuss important matters.

The lords who received the news were all shocked.

This Wang Shuo, who actually has such a magnanimity, has made countless people look at him with new eyes.

This time, he is in public, so he is not afraid of Wang Shuo's tricks.

Last time, some lords were worried about going to Wang Shuo's territory and were afraid of encountering unexpected events, so they did not go.

This time, there is naturally no such concern.

Soon, even those lords who had not been present to watch the battle between Wang Shuo and Nanshan Ji, after hearing the news, rushed over at full speed.

It was as if missing this meeting would mean missing out on hundreds of millions.

An hour later, the number of lords present had reached more than 60.

This could be said to be the first time in the Dahuai Territory that so many lords had gathered together, which had great historical significance.

"Everyone, thank you for giving me, Wang, face and being able to come here to participate in this event!"

Wang Shuo stood up and raised his glass to everyone.

The lords also stood up and raised their glasses in response.

"This time, resisting Nanshan Ji was really a helpless move. Nanshan Ji relied on its strong military and horses to collect protection fees everywhere, making us miserable."

Wang Shuo directly unified his position with that of the lords and put himself in a position of being oppressed.

Many lords who were charged protection fees felt the same way.
